items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Mr. Bill went over there and brought him a violin and gave it to him.

ctx.x: But you know him? Now you see, now a lot of people, you know a lot of people ask me about him? They thought he could play. No, he couldn't play nothing. Now that man, you know what I mean, that man been following us for years and years and years and years. Well, we go to that man and follow us. Uh huh. And uh, but he can't play nothing. But one thing, he know how to tune that violin. He can tune it. Oh yeah, he can. He really can tune that violin up in the right pitch, you know what I'm talking about? But just…

Thomas, you got time for one more? It's 435 now. For what? 435. 25 till 5. We better get up time, up the river? Yeah, we'll get up. Well, we'll call it to a halt then, because we just, this one's just about to run off. So we'll just let it run off then. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And we'll do it another time. Maybe you can come over by my house if you want to. Yeah, sure, yeah, sure. If you like, you see, and I can give you a gallon of whiskey. I think I'm over for breakfast, though.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: So Mr. Bill said, well, what do you use if you say you're going to sue him, he's going to do nothing.

ctx.x: Sam Childers? Sam Childers, yeah, he had a tape recorder. That was Dr. Pepper from France, that man's name was Dr. Pepper. That was Dr. Pepper?

Sure. That's his name. Yeah, so look, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand facing the wall like this, towards the river. And we had a little room, always to put all the, you know, you come in, you come in in the back, you know, they had a little room, always to put all the airspace. And you know, like you want to leave your ampers, your drum, the thing, or a little room and lock it up. So they came there that night and they took, that man couldn't speak a word…
